parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the reported vulnerability is not applicable. The buffer size passed to recvfrom is fixed and does not account for potential larger input sizes, but the code already ensures that only sizeof(uint32_t) bytes are received.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code already ensures that only sizeof(uint32_t) bytes are received by specifying the buffer size as sizeof(uint32_t) in the recvfrom function call. This prevents the buffer overflow by limiting the amount of data that can be read into the buffer.
